keywords.def: a word we cannot sound out in the usual way: said, could
a check to see what we know
reading smoothly, without stopping at every word

questions.q: Core: read the tricky word cards to a partner or adult, then write five of them
Extend: write a sentence with two tricky words
questions.a: For example: Our people said thank you.

questions.q: Stretch: read a page of your decodable book fluently
Which word is a tricky word?
questions.a: B) said. said: ai says /e/ here, so it is tricky. sky and bridge use sounds we know.
